details.name: MOB.365_Work_Reassign_Stage
details.message:
`MOB.365` **Reassign a work stage and SAVE — proved on the server, then restored.**
- On its own Datadog-created work order `xohY0klBZktB9VBRxc8k4J` (work `20260910-16`).
- `Assign Work Stage` → `Account Executive`, `Keep local copy` OFF → ⭐ `/graphql`: `Account Executive` added and
  `Admin` removed (REMOVE_WORK_STAGE_FROM_CREW + ADD_ASSIGNMENT_TO_WORKSTAGE), the rest untouched.
- Restore (`always`): the same modal, `Admin` with `Keep local copy` ON → `/graphql` proves it; the UI
  cannot remove a crew other than the session's, so a net un-assigns `Account Executive` over `/graphql`.
  Ends on a hard read: exactly the 8 crews at rest.
- `MOB.398` stays the read-only modal check.

steps.name: Navigate to /work — warm the work lookup cache
Let the work list begin rendering
The "Work Orders" page mounted
Let the lookup prefetch run
Navigate to the reassign work order (20260910-16)
Let the detail view begin rendering
Test work order detail rendered
PREMISE (server): the stage's crews are exactly the 8 at rest (`Admin` among them), `Account Executive` is not one of them, and the stage has no schedule entry
Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys

params.code:
['__dd365_server', '__dd365_server:inflight', '__dd365_server:at'].forEach(k => sessionStorage.removeItem(k));
return true;

steps.name: Click "Assign Work Stage" (forward)
Wait for the modal and its auto-opened crew dropdown
The crew form rendered
Search the crew picker for "Account Executive"
Wait for the crew options (network-only)
Pick "Account Executive" — the one VISIBLE option titled exactly "Account Executive"
The crew field now holds "Account Executive"

params.code:
const el = document.getElementById('crewId');
return !!el && (el.value || '').trim() === 'Account Executive';

steps.name: "Keep local copy of work?" is OFF (the default) — the save sends the REMOVE too

params.code:
const el = document.getElementById('keepAssignment');
return !!el && el.checked === false;

steps.name: SUBMIT is ARMED — `type="submit"` (trap 8)
SUBMIT — assign to Account Executive
Let the mutations reach the server
The `Work stage has been assigned to …` toast for Account Executive (optional: transient)

params.value: Work stage has been assigned to

steps.name: The crew modal closed and the detail page's `Assign Work Stage` is back — the modal closes in ADD_ASSIGNMENT's update() (no optimistic response), so the server answered the ADD

params.code:
if (document.getElementById('crewform')) return false;
return [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('Assign Work Stage'));

steps.name: ⭐ SERVER: SAVED — `Account Executive` holds the stage and `Admin` no longer does (REMOVE + ADD), the other 7 crews untouched — asked over /graphql
Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys

params.code:
['__dd365_server', '__dd365_server:inflight', '__dd365_server:at'].forEach(k => sessionStorage.removeItem(k));
return true;
